title: Journey polish: unlisted reads as live, every create road is governed, templates load whole, search schema shows real steps

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: Four small findings from the Journey audit. (1) components/journey/v2/journey-builder.tsx treated only 'public' as live, so an unlisted Journey (already joinable by link) kept offering Publish, which flipped it public. (2) createMasterFrameworkAction wrote the plan with createPlan directly, the one create road outside proposeAndConfirmCreate (ADR-988, ADR-1249). (3) The guide's applyTemplate ignored insert errors, leaving a half skeleton that the phase-count check then refused to replace. (4) journeySchema emitted every row as a HowToStep, phases and modules included (a 12-phase Journey with no lessons claimed 24 steps), and always used the site image instead of the Journey cover. Fixed 2026-11-18. Not fixed here: Journey notices still land on /journeys because the notification row carries the plan id, not the slug (lib/notifications/href.ts, pinned by href.test.ts).

verify.note: Fails if unlisted stops reading as live, the Master Framework road leaves the governed create, the guide template stops checking inserts, or the HowTo schema lists containers or drops the cover.
